body:

### Summary

Bug Report: Account Access Issue

Describe the bug: My Streamlit Cloud account has been blocked with error code 403, claiming fair-use limits exceeded.

Error Details:

Error Code: 403
Message: "Your account has exceeded the fair-use limits and was blocked by the system. If you believe this is a mistake, please contact customer support."
Account GitHub: curious-sherlock
Expected behavior: Account should remain accessible as we haven't deployed many applications and are within reasonable usage limits.

Additional context:

We are a startup in stealth mode testing the platform
Minimal app deployments so far
Evaluating for potential premium upgrade
Need account restored to continue evaluation
Environment:

Streamlit Cloud
Request: Please review and restore account access. Happy to provide additional details if needed.
